bio_en: Father Mesrop Avetisian, known as Makuetsi Mesrop, had no higher or secondary schooling; life and public service were his school. A veteran ARF comrade, he worked with Keri, Toros and Dro in the Persian-Armenian revolutionary milieu and inspired those around him with his gentleness and enthusiasm. As a priest he devoted himself to the community with selfless sacrifice. He died in Rezaiyeh (formerly Urmia) in 1936.
